# DGX Station GB300 serving research

> Measured LLM serving results from one NVIDIA DGX Station GB300 (SM 10.3, ~250 GiB HBM, Grace LPDDR5X over NVLink-C2C) plus an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q (SM 12.0, 96 GB, PCIe) in the same host, 2026-09-23..28. Models: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. The main technique is an expert "sidecar": MoE experts that do not fit in GB300 HBM live on, and are computed by, the RTX PRO 6000; the GB300 exchanges only the affected token rows through pinned host memory inside CUDA graphs.

How to use this repository as an agent:
- Every quoted number is one row in data/results.jsonl (or data/results.csv). Rows have a fixed schema (data/README.md), and each row cites the raw file it came from (`source`). Filter on `lane`, `config`, `benchmark` and `metric`.
- `qualified: false` means the configuration never passed a quality gate. `source: null` means the value came from session notes, and the raw output was not kept. Rows whose `config` starts with `external:` are third-party published numbers.
- catid's DeepSeek-V4.1 numbers are from two DGX Stations; do not compare them with single-GPU numbers as equals. b12x conclusions apply only to the model and quantization mix measured.
- Scripts are verbatim snapshots with station-specific absolute paths (/home/jasonc/research/<lane> = <lane dir> in this repo) and GPU UUIDs.
